reading: CSS Communications operates a Tier III certified colocation data center branded CSSNW at 1911 C Street in Bellingham, Washington, marketed as one of the most connected buildings in Whatcom County. The facility is marketed in part through ColocationM, a colocation marketplace and services company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, though the precise ownership relationship between CSS Communications and ColocationM, whether marketing partnership or parent-subsidiary, was not fully clarified in available sources. CSSNW offers hosting configurations ranging from single servers and partial cabinets to full 46U cabinets and multi-rack cages, with 110 volt, 208 volt, and negative 48 volt DC power delivery options, redundant HVAC, natural gas backup generation, FM 200 clean agent fire suppression, and biometric access control. The facility connects to six peering networks and major carriers and offers 24/7 remote hands technical support alongside a 99.99 percent uptime service level commitment. As a regional Pacific Northwest colocation provider serving the Bellingham and Whatcom County market near the US-Canada border, CSS Communications occupies a niche distinct from the metro-scale wholesale and hyperscale operators concentrated in larger markets elsewhere in this registry.
